evidence.title: ChatDeck — Free Shadcn UI SaaS Landing Page Template (Next.js + Tailwind)

name: ChatDeck
summary: Free Next.js 16 SaaS landing page template with shadcn/ui sections, pricing toggle and dark mode.
description: A free shadcn/ui landing page template for SaaS products, built with Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Base UI and Motion animations. It ships as independently editable section components — hero, sticky nav, video, social proof, features with Lucide icons, team, testimonials, pricing with a monthly/yearly toggle, and an accordion FAQ — plus dark mode with an animated theme toggler. MIT licensed, no paid tier.
contains: free SaaS landing page template, MIT licensed, no paid tier
stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Base UI
sections: hero, sticky nav, video, social proof, features, team, testimonials, pricing, FAQ
testimonials marquee, pricing monthly/yearly toggle, accordion FAQ
